label: EPISTEMIC_REASON_2: Inquiry.supports w e p says that at w the fact e is admitted as a reason to…
definition: Inquiry.supports w e p says that at w the fact e is admitted as a reason to accept p; Supported I w p says some fact is. It is a primitive parameter, not assumed factive, transitive, asymmetric or well-founded, and it says nothing about why p obtains. Smoke is a reason to accept that there is a fire and no reason why there is one.
